id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

initiallyExpanded.description: Whether the side panel is initially expanded or collapsed.

isExpanded.description: Whether the side panel is collapsed

isFullyExpanded.description: Whether the side panel is fully expanded to its max width

applicationStateId.description: The id of the {@link GenAiUiApplicationState} this feed interacts with

feedApplicationStateId.description: The id of the {@link GenAiUiFeedApplicationState} this feed interacts with

uiSettings.description: UI Settings dependent on the backend configuration

queryToolOptions.description:
The query tool options available to the user. This allows the user to target a specific tool when submitting a
query.

agentConfigName.description:
The agent config name to use for the query. If one is specified, all queries will be submitted to this agent and
the agent selector will not be displayed.

addResultIdQueryParam.description:
Whether to the resultId of the GenAI result should be tracked as a query param in the URL.
This allows to reload the conversation on page refresh.

initialExpandedWidth.description: The initial width of the side panel when expanded after being collapsed.

fullyExpandedWidth.description: The full width of the side panel when expanded with the "expand / full screen" button.

searchPlaceholder.description: The placeholder text for the search input field

className.description: Additional classname to apply to the side panel for styling purposes.

headerTitle.description: The title of the side panel header

headerIcon.description: The icon to display in the side panel header

behavior.description:
The expand/collapse behavior of the side panel.
- `overlay` - The side panel will be displayed on top of the page.
- `block` - The side panel will push the page content on expand and collapse.
